Ethylene glycol is a chemical used to prevent water from freezing. If ethylene glycol is swallowed

prevents formation of a toxic product and allows the body to excrete the ethylene glycol.

B Ethanol binds permanently to the active site of the enzyme, blocking it.
C Ethanol changes the tertiary structure of the enzyme, denaturing it.
